days.artist: Constantijn van Renesse (formerly attributed to Rembrandt)
days.title: The Good Samaritan
days.alt: Two men carry a wounded, bandaged man between them in an inn yard while a third helps with his legs.
days.look: Look again at the wounded man carried so carefully across the yard. Where in you does the hurt need someone to carry it?
days.license: Artist died 1680; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)

days.file: Brooklyn Museum - Jesus Wept (Jésus pleura) - James Tissot.jpg
days.title: Jesus Wept
days.alt: Jesus, in a white robe, sits on a hillside outside the city with his head bowed, while mourners stand behind and a woman kneels at his side.
days.look: Look again at Jesus in white, his head bowed. What sorrow would you let him share with you today?
days.license: Artist died 1902; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)

days.title: The Dream of Joseph
days.alt: In a dim, stable-like room, a winged angel in a glowing robe appears above the sleeping Joseph, who rests with his head on his hand beside Mary.
days.look: Look again at the angel’s light breaking into Joseph’s sleep. What mercy might God be asking you to choose before anger sets in?
days.license: Artist died 1669; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)

days.file: Michiel Coignet II (1618-1663) - The Prodigal Son Departs* - 80 - Lamport Hall.jpg
days.title: The Prodigal Son Departs
days.alt: A young man on a white horse rides out from a great house while an elderly man reaches up to him and a small group watches.
days.look: Look again at the old father reaching up to the son on the white horse. What would it mean to wish someone well and let them go?
days.license: Artist died 1663; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)

days.title: The Wedding at Cana
days.alt: Mary in blue and Jesus in red sit side by side at the wedding table, Mary turned toward her Son as she speaks.
days.look: Look again at Mary turned toward her Son, speaking for others. Whom would you like to name to God with a blessing?
days.license: Artist died 1319; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)

days.title: The Good Shepherd
days.alt: Christ in a red robe holds a lamb in the crook of his arm, with a shepherd’s staff in his hand and a sunset behind him.
days.look: Look again at the lamb held close in his arm. What would it mean to rest in a love that does not let go?
days.license: Artist died 1907; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)

days.file: Gerrit van Honthorst - Childhood of Christ - WGA11656.jpg
days.title: The Childhood of Christ
days.alt: In the light of a single candle, the bearded Joseph works with a chisel while the boy Jesus holds the flame over the bench.
days.look: Look again at Joseph’s steady hands in the candlelight. What small, daily act of patience could you offer today?
days.license: Artist died 1656; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)

days.file: Rembrandt Simeon and Anna in the Temple@Kunsthalle Hamburg.jpg
days.title: Simeon and Anna in the Temple
days.alt: Old Simeon in a gold robe holds the swaddled Child while Mary looks on, and Anna raises her hands behind them.
days.look: Look again at old Simeon holding the Child he waited for. What would it be to wait quietly today, without hurrying the answer?
days.license: Artist died 1669; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)

days.file: Annunciation - Jan van Eyck - 1434 - NG Wash DC.jpg
days.title: The Annunciation
days.alt: Mary, in a blue mantle, raises both open hands as she answers the angel.
days.look: Look again at Mary’s open hands as she answers the angel. What are you ready to place in God’s hands today?
days.license: Artist died 1441; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)
